title: Coherent transport between dg functor models
statement: Use derived enrichment and enhanced localization of dg categories over $\mathbf Z$ as in [lem-coef-dg-enrichment-rectification], and coherent enriched internal Hom, evaluation, composition and identities as in [lem-coef-enriched-category-tensor-calculus]. Fix a small collection of small dg categories. For every ordered pair $(\mathcal A,\mathcal B)$ in the collection put $\mathcal F(\mathcal A,\mathcal B)=\operatorname{Fun}_{\mathbf D(\mathbf Z)}(\mathcal A,\mathcal B)$. Suppose two families of small dg models $\mathcal R_i(\mathcal A,\mathcal B)$, $i=1,2$, have specified enriched equivalences $e_i(\mathcal A,\mathcal B):\mathcal R_i(\mathcal A,\mathcal B)\simeq\mathcal F(\mathcal A,\mathcal B)$. The coherent evaluation, composition, identities and all their higher compatibility homotopies on $\mathcal F$ admit transport to each family along the $e_i$. For the transported structures the pairwise equivalences $e_2^{-1}e_1:\mathcal R_1(\mathcal A,\mathcal B)\simeq\mathcal R_2(\mathcal A,\mathcal B)$ respect these operations with all higher compatibility homotopies. They identify the derived transformation objects in $\mathbf D(\mathbf Z)$.

source.place: Haugseng, On the tensor product of enriched infinity-categories, Remark 9.5 and Corollary 10.8; transport of its coherent internal-Hom operations along enriched equivalences. Agent specialization, read online, not archived. No Stacks tag supplies this enriched coherence lemma.
